title: Time series causal discovery with variable lags
abstract: arXiv:2605.04081v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Causal Bayesian Networks (CBNs) are a powerful tool for reasoning under uncertainty about complex real-world problems. Such problems evolve over time, responding to external shocks as they occur. To support decision-making, CBNs require a cause-and-effect map of the variables under consideration, known as the network's structure. Learning the graphical structure of a causal model from data remains challenging; learning it from time-series data is even harder because dependencies may arise at different time lags. We construct a method that jointly learns a temporal ordering and a dominant lag for each selected ordered variable pair. Our contribution is a decomposable BIC-style objective score for mixed data that combines node-specific sample sizes with a penalty favouring recent lags. translated_title: 具有可变滞后项的时间序列因果发现
translated_abstract: 因果贝叶斯网络是在不确定条件下对复杂现实世界问题进行推理的强大工具。这类问题随时间演变，并在外部冲击发生时作出响应。为支持决策，因果贝叶斯网络需要一张关于所研究变量的因果关系图，即网络的结构。从数据中学习因果模型的图结构仍然具有挑战性；而从时间序列数据中学习则更加困难，因为变量间的依赖关系可能出现在不同的时间滞后处。我们构建了一种方法，可以联合学习变量的时间顺序以及每个选定有序变量对的主导滞后项。我们的贡献是一个适用于混合数据的可分解 BIC 风格目标评分函数，它将节点特定的样本量与偏向近期滞后项的惩罚项相结合。我们使用禁忌搜索对该目标函数进行优化，并通过改变滞后项的搜索动作和贪心的逐子节点滞后调整加以增强，同时其节点级可分解性……
tldr: 本文提出了一种可分解的BIC风格评分方法，用于联合学习时间序列因果发现中的变量时间顺序与每个有序变量对的主导滞后项，并通过增强的禁忌搜索算法进行优化。
en_tdlr: A decomposable BIC-style score is proposed to jointly learn temporal ordering and dominant lags for variable pairs in time series causal discovery, optimized via an enhanced Tabu search with change-lag moves.
